text:
marta: Heads up — nightly eval showing a sharp drop on pset v8 for the quantized rollout (q4_0). Metric regression ~8% on QA exact match and some syntax hallucinations. :warning:

samir: on it. which model + commit?

marta: model: redwood/opt-30b-q4_0@2026-03-18, promptset: pset_v8 (just promoted yesterday), eval run id: nightly-18091

eval-bot: nightly-18091 completed. details: overall EM -8.2%, F1 -5.7%, halluc rate +3.4pp. Failing buckets: negation, list-generation.

priya: quick hypothesis — pset v8 introduced a few new examples that rely on token-level spacing (we added a leading newline in some prompts). q4 tokenizers sometimes merge newline tokens differently.

alex_g: did a tiny repro: tokenizer.encode('
What is 2+2?') vs tokenizer.encode('What is 2+2?') gives different prefix ids on q4 model. example:
```
# tokenizer outputs (q4)
encode('
What is 2+2?') -> [102, 45, 67, ...]
encode('What is 2+2?')  -> [45, 67, ...]
```
That shifts cached KV offsets for generation.

samir: aha. so not a semantic model regression but a tokenization/prompt formatting delta interacting with quantized runtime cache.

marta: can we confirm this causes the specific failure modes (negation/list)?

priya: i ran a focused eval on 200 negation cases toggling leading newline. with newline -> EM drops 12%, without -> baseline. looks correlated.

jamie: options: 1) revert pset v8 to v7 immediately, 2) rebaseline prompts to remove leading newlines and cosmetic whitespace, 3) add a pre-tokenize normalization in serving for q4 variants.

alex_g: 3 is safer long-term but needs infra changes and regression testing. 2 is quick but modifies golden prompts (needs approval). 1 is fastest rollback for customer-facing stability.

ops-bot: production traffic for q4_0 in dedicated is ~15% of requests, no active incidents.

marta: recommendation: rollback pset v8 from nightly and open a patch PR to rebaseline prompts (option 2) with a clear changelog referencing tokenizer normalization. also run end-to-end on q4 and fp16.

samir: i'll open the rollback PR now. tagging @jamie @priya for rebaseline plan.

jamie: please include a tiny script that normalizes leading/trailing whitespace and runs tokenizer parity check across model variants. example check we can include:
```
# parity check pseudocode
for prompt in pset:
  ids_fp16 = tok_fp16.encode(prompt)
  ids_q4   = tok_q4.encode(prompt)
  if ids_fp16[:4] != ids_q4[:4]:
    report(prompt)
```

priya: ack. i'll draft the prompt edits and tests. will also run the eval harness overnight.

marta: approval needed from eng-ml leads to proceed with rollback + rebaseline patch flow. @jamie @alex_g please react or confirm. :eyes:

jamie: +1 to rollback then rebaseline.

alex_g: +1. prioritize a token-normalization unit test in CI.

marta: thanks. samir — assign the rollback PR to @ops oncall for deploy. priya/jamie collaborate on the rebaseline PR with eval results attached.

samir: rollback PR opened: https://git.company/repo/promptsets/pulls/1123 (title: revert pset_v8 due to tokenizer delta). assigned to ops oncall.

eval-bot: scheduled targeted eval run: nightly-18092 (pset_v7 vs rebased_pset_v8) — will post diffs when done.

marta: moving the rest of convo to the PR for detailed diffs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
